projects.title: AutoForge - Multi-Agent AI Automation SaaS Platform
projects.description: From idea to web app in 2 hours. 4 specialized AI agents transform your description into a fully tested, deployed, and production-ready application. Strategic migration Vertex AI → Claude SDK: -55% costs, -28% latency.
features: 4-phase automated pipeline: PO Agent → Tech Lead → Executor → QA
Multi-agent orchestration via Claude SDK + in-process MCP (zero latency)
Technical migration Vertex AI → Claude: -55% costs, -28% latency, -80% errors
Isolated VMs per project (Spot VMs with automatic preemption handling)
Real-time WebSocket logs + Live Preview iframe
Complete export: ZIP, GitHub push, or Cloud Run deployment
Time-to-Market: <2h from idea to production-ready MVP
Scalable serverless architecture (Cloud Run + Firestore)
projects.architectureDesc: Serverless multi-agent architecture on GCP. Claude SDK orchestrates 4 specialized agents on Cloud Run, with Firestore for persistence and isolated Spot VMs for code execution.

projects.title: Mimo Finance - Collaborative Financial Management App
projects.description: Modern web application for personal and couple financial management with unified timeline, automatic projections, and couple mode. Deployed on GCP Cloud Run with complete Terraform infrastructure.
features: Continuous financial timeline (past → present → future over 12 months)
Couple mode with 3 tracked wallets + merge/split functionality
Automatic projections for recurring transactions
Automatic daily validation via Cloud Scheduler
Complete GCP infrastructure (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Redis, VPC)
CI/CD with GitHub Actions (tests, SonarCloud, automatic deployment)
Terraform IaC for total reproducibility
Unit + integration tests with 85%+ coverage
projects.architectureDesc: 3-tier serverless architecture on GCP. React frontend + FastAPI backend on Cloud Run, Cloud SQL PostgreSQL with VPC peering, Redis for caching, and Cloud Scheduler for automatic validations.

projects.title: Multi-Cloud Portfolio Infrastructure
projects.description: Portfolio deployed on AWS ECS and GCP Cloud Run with Terraform for IaC
features: Multi-cloud deployment (AWS ECS Fargate + GCP Cloud Run)
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform (reusable modules)
Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions
Container Registry (AWS ECR + GCP Artifact Registry)
Lifecycle policies for cost optimization (~$15/month)
Serverless architecture with scale-to-zero
projects.architectureDesc: Multi-cloud deployment with Terraform. Containerized React SPA on AWS ECS Fargate and GCP Cloud Run, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Cloudflare DNS, and integrated GCP monitoring.

projects.title: Reetik - AI Viral Video Generator
projects.description: Complete pipeline for automatic generation of viral TikTok/Shorts videos in ~6-10 minutes. Uses Gemini 2.5 Pro, Veo 3.1 (cinematic HD quality), Google TTS Premium, and Whisper. React interface + FastAPI backend on Cloud Run.
features: AI script generation with Gemini 2.5 Pro
Premium voiceover (natural Gemini voice)
Creative video clips generated by Veo 3.1 (cinematic HD 1080p quality)
TikTok-style synchronized subtitles (Whisper + ASS)
Optimized format: 9:16, 64-80 seconds, HD 1080p
Fully automated pipeline: 1 request → complete video in ~6-10 min
React Frontend + FastAPI Backend deployed on Cloud Run
CI/CD with GitHub Actions + Terraform IaC
JWT authentication + quota system (2 videos/user)
Real-time WebSocket progress tracking
projects.architectureDesc: Event-driven video generation pipeline on GCP. React frontend + FastAPI backend on Cloud Run, Cloud Functions Gen2 for async processing, Firestore + Cloud Storage for persistence, and Veo 3.1 for video generation.

projects.title: Job Hunter - AI-Powered Automated Job Search Platform
projects.description: DevOps/Cloud job search automation with AI scraping (OpenClaw + headless Chromium), LLM analysis (Claude Sonnet 4), CV/cover letter adaptation and PDF generation (Playwright). Multi-user with Firebase authentication, deployed on GCP Cloud Run.
features: Automated scraping — OpenClaw + headless Chromium scrapes WTTJ and Indeed every 6h via Cloud Scheduler
LLM analysis — Claude Sonnet 4 analyzes each offer and calculates a matching score
PDF generation — Playwright generates pixel-perfect customized CVs and cover letters
Multi-user with individual profiles, search criteria, and offer management
Manual offer addition — Paste a URL → automatic extraction + LLM pipeline
CSV export of filtered offers + email notifications after each scraping run
Portfolio mode (admin/visitor) — free navigation, only admin triggers costly operations
Complete Terraform infrastructure (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Scheduler, Artifact Registry)
projects.architectureDesc: Microservices architecture on GCP. React frontend + FastAPI backend + OpenClaw AI agent, each on Cloud Run. Cloud SQL PostgreSQL with VPC peering, Cloud Scheduler for automated scraping every 6h, and Firebase for authentication.
